entry.name: bondo
entry.description: Synchronizes and outputs a set of inputs when any input is received. It can also be set with a time interval value (in milliseconds) to wait before sending its output.

arguments.name: inlets-outlets
arguments.digest: The number of inlets and outlets
arguments.description: Specifies the number of inlets and outlets. The default number of inlets and outlets is 2.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.description: Specifies the number of milliseconds to delay when a message is received before sending messages out the outlets.

arguments.name: list-flag
arguments.description: Using the symbol "n" as an argument,is able to synchronize lists which arrive in different inlets.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: In any inlet: The input is stored in the location corresponding to that inlet, and causes anything previously stored to be sent out its corresponding outlet. If no message has yet been received in a particular inlet, 0 is sent out of the corresponding outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In any inlet: The input is stored in the location corresponding to that inlet, and causes anything previously stored to be sent out its corresponding outlet. If no message has yet been received in a particular inlet, 0 is sent out of the corresponding outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In any inlet: The input is stored in the location corresponding to that inlet, and causes anything previously stored to be sent out its corresponding outlet. If no message has yet been received in a particular inlet, 0 is sent out of the corresponding outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In any inlet: The elements of the list are parsed among the inlets. The first element in the list is sent out the outlet which corresponds to the inlet which received the list and each subsequent element in the list is sent out each subsequent outlet.If the "n" argument was used,will store and output lists for each outlet in addition to single numbers.

messages.name: set
messages.description: In any inlet: The word, followed by any message, stores the input in the location corresponding to that inlet without triggering any output.
